title: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for GUI Reward Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.24174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies on GUI agents have increasingly focused on outcome reward modeling, which assigns outcome rewards by judging whether an executed trajectory satisfies the success criteria implied by the user instruction. Existing GUI reward verifiers, however, often under-specify how these criteria should be constructed for each task instance. Whether using generic rubric structures or implicit model reasoning, their judging criteria are not sufficiently task-adaptive: they can transfer checks across tasks, overlook concrete constraints in the current instruction, or become overly strict by enforcing unstated requirements. To address this limitation, we propose AdaptRubric, a Coarse-to-Fine Rubrics Framework that constructs task-adaptive judging criteria through a category-level coarse stage and an instance-level fine stage. translated_title: 任务自适应评分标准用于图形用户界面奖励建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24174v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近期关于图形用户界面（GUI）代理的研究越来越关注结果奖励建模，即通过判断执行轨迹是否满足用户指令中隐含的成功标准来分配结果奖励。然而，现有的GUI奖励验证器往往未能充分指定每个任务实例应如何构建这些标准。无论是使用通用评分标准结构还是隐式模型推理，它们的判断标准不够任务自适应：它们可能在任务间转移检查、忽视当前指令中的具体约束，或因强制执行未明确说明的要求而变得过于严格。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了AdaptRubric，一种粗到细的评分标准框架，通过类别级粗阶段和实例级细阶段构建任务自适应的判断标准。AdaptRubric通过将指令路由到GUI任务族并进行检索来执行类别级粗评分标准检索。
tldr: 本文提出AdaptRubric框架，通过粗到细的两阶段方法构建任务自适应的GUI奖励判断标准，解决了现有验证器标准不够自适应的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AdaptRubric, a coarse-to-fine framework that constructs task-adaptive judging criteria for GUI reward modeling, addressing the limitation of insufficiently adaptive criteria in existing verifiers.
